title: Kubota Recalls Utility Vehicles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The floor mats on the recalled Kubota utility vehicles can warp or degrade and interfere with the throttle pedal, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 48,875.

title: Power Handles Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Manufactured by Elektron Music Machines
summary: The power handle can short circuit and overheat, posing fire and burn hazards Units: About 660 (In addition, about 37 were sold in Canada).

title: Usines Giant Factories Recalls Gas Water Heaters with Emerson Control Valves Due to Risk of Carbon Monoxide Poisoning
summary: The power handle can short circuit and overheat, posing fire and burn hazards Units: About 168 (in addition, about 10,832 were sold in Canada).

title: Amazon Recalls AmazonBasics Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 15,300.

title: American Honda Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The vehicles can lose steering function, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 1,400.

title: Goodman Manufacturing Company Recalls Evaporator Coil Drain Pans Installed with Condensing Gas Furnaces Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The molded plastic drain pan located at the bottom of the evaporator coil, when installed with a residential condensing gas furnace in an up-flow configuration, can overheat, melt, and deform, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 298,300 (In addition, about 44,000 in Canada).

title: Hanna Andersson Recalls Baby Long Sleeve Wiggle Sets Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The snaps on the long sleeve top can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 4,400 (10 were sold in Canada).

title: Hanna Andersson Recalls Baby Ruffle Rompers Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The snaps on the romper can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children Units: About 3,200 (10 were sold in Canada).

title: RH Recalls Outdoor Torches Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Torch fuel can leak from the top of the torch canister and ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,200 (In addition, about 40 units were sold in Canada).

title: VidaXL Recalls Ladders for Above-Ground Pools Due to Fall and Drowning Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The steps of the ladder can loosen during use, posing fall and drowning hazards to the user. Units: About 3,200.

title: ABUS Recalls Youth Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the U.S. CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 790.

title: Hart Consumer Products Recalls Nailers Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The contact sensor on the nailer can malfunction and involuntarily discharge a nail, posing a risk of serious injury to the user or bystanders. Units: About 15,700.

title: Impex Fitness Recalls Dumbbell Handles Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: The locking collars on the dumbbell handles can slip, dropping weights when held perpendicular to the floor, posing an impact injury hazard. Units: About 77,200.
